what: Evaluation of public release feasibility for sv-memory
why: The user asked if the project is robust enough to be distributed publicly.
learned: sv-memory is robust enough for public release. Its database connection pool tuning (WAL mode and single writer lock serializing), pure Go sqlite implementation (modernc.org), and unit test coverage make it production-ready. Pre-release tasks include setting up GoReleaser (CI/CD) and translating the README to English.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
